models.why: confirm-only item. Brow band now sits above the eyes, no beak, no cheek incisions (better than live). But in the game renderer the painted eyes do not read: at the 0.9 m close-up (300 and 600 px cells) they are tiny low-contrast grey marks with no visible blue iris (the Cycles card shows blue lidded eyes; three does not), and at the in-match pitch only the brow band, nose and mouth show. With the pale smooth plate on the ribbed wooden dowel neck the head reads near-blank / mannequin-like at close. Needs larger, darker iris and lid line on the plate (the implementer flagged the same in ruling 57). Hands fine; silhouette, crest, blades and colour plan unchanged.

notched eye band and mouth wrap gone: a calm carved face with brows, lidded brown eyes with iris and pupil, nose and a closed mouth, scarf under the chin, all three skins; low rounded hood (no peak). Reads at the in-match pitch (eyes, nose under the hood rim). Problems, not tripwires: a small black dot/dash on the forehead in every skin (texture artifact), cream islands in the green zone-graded hood beside the face (base), stair-stepped dark stripes on the hood lining at the left of the face (Shadeprint, base cards) that read like scratches at 128 px; the smooth egg face is plain. In game the base hood is green while every card shows it cream (pre-existing card/model mismatch).

eye window in her skin with two lidded eyes (white, brown iris, pupil) in all three skins; hood rounded and low; wrap below the eyes kept. Gloves: one closed shape round the staff on both hands, no fragments; fingers are fused into a block (reads as a glove, not finger-by-finger). At the 52 deg match pitch the hood brim hides the eyes (only the wrap shows), which is geometry, unchanged. Hand probe min ratio 0.401 (band floor 0.4).

the glass band over the eyes is a slim circlet over the brow; open lidded hazel eyes, small smile, headscarf wrap framing the face, cyan wrap kept (base). From the 52 deg pitch the circlet sits above the eyes, not across them (no blindfold read). Friendly, the best of the six. Minor: Gorgewalk face is two-tone (orange lower face vs grey upper) on its portrait.

slanted black slits replaced by level shallow recesses with open painted eyes (white, brown iris, pupil, upper lid) in all three skins; stoic, not a void. Left fist closed through (no hole) in the hand close-up; it is a small lumpy pale fist but reads as a fist. Mask cracks, stitches, cap and colours unchanged (design). At the match pitch the brim box hides the eyes.

hand only, head untouched (same face, tally marks and brow in all skins). The cleaver fist now shows finger rolls and knuckle lumps wrapped round the hilt from front, side and above; no longer a fingerless mitten, though the segments are soft and lumpy rather than crisp. GLB 1171.5 KiB (budget 1172); the thinned keyframes and texture quality do not show at the face or fist.
